summary: Full suite verified green. One pre-existing, diff-unrelated contention flake observed (sandbox_pool_test.exs RT-6), not caused by this branch. All 4 originally-affected files plus the new regression test file pass cleanly.

runs.detail: 4 of 16 partitions (2, 10, 15, 16) crashed outright with zero Result: lines -- each hit a Postgrex.Protocol DBConnection.ConnectionError ('checked out the connection for longer than 15000ms') inside Letflow.Test.TenantTemplate.ensure_template!/0 during Code.require_file/2 of the tenant migration module, i.e. a compile-time connection-pool-timeout crash before any test executed. This matches README.md's documented ISS-0219 class verbatim: 'if nproc-derived N exceeds this host's Postgres/CPU capacity, every partition can crash outright during ecto.create/ecto.migrate before any test result is produced... set TEST_PARALLEL_N explicitly to a smaller value (4 is known-good on at least one dev host) rather than assuming a code regression.' Treated as a known host-capacity artifact of N=16, not a suite result -- re-ran at TEST_PARALLEL_N=4 per README guidance for a valid signal.

failure.diagnosis: Pre-existing, diff-unrelated contention-class flake. `git diff origin/main --stat` for this branch shows ZERO changes to test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs or lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex -- this file is not in ISS-0878's diff at all. Same file/describe block as the already-tracked ISS-0881 ('SandboxPoolTest ISS-0224 regression RT-6 (death path c) fails intermittently under full parallel suite', status: resolved 2026-09-29T07:50:00Z), though this specific failure mode (a wait_until_schema_dropped timeout, i.e. reaper reclaim running too slowly under N=4 contention) is a timing symptom rather than ISS-0881's originally-fixed platform-wide-assertion mechanism -- consistent with the same general contention-class flake family (ISS-0873/ISS-0878-unrelated/ISS-0879/ISS-0881) resurfacing under load rather than a regression this branch introduced.
failure.route_recommendation: Not blocking ISS-0878's closure. Worth a follow-up queue entry if it recurs, but out of scope for TEST-RUNNER (routes to ISSUE-FIXER only if the user wants it root-caused as its own ticket).
